# Jwenv engine (vendored, unmodified)

- Source: https://huggingface.co/spaces/kishida/jwenv-demo
- Revision: `8263b814fde5ca11e47718a7ac82945639c02d8d` (checked 2026-09-22)
- Author: kishida
- License: MIT, as declared in the Space card metadata (`license: mit`). The Space
  does not ship a separate LICENSE file, so the MIT permission notice is reproduced
  below with the Space owner as the copyright holder.

`manifest.json` lists every copied file with its upstream path and SHA-256.
`scripts/jwenv_lab/test_contract.py` fails if a file is edited, so local changes
belong in `../../app.mjs` or `../../core.mjs`, not here.

The model weights are not vendored. The lab page loads a GGUF file that the user
selects locally (`kishida/jwenv-0.6b-poc-gguf`, Apache-2.0).
